name: Lookup Member Balance
description: Look up a member and read their current savings balance

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: Member identifier supplied by the caller.

outputs.name: savings_balance
outputs.description: Read from the surface during discovery.

steps.intent: Open the application at its recorded entry point.

strategies.rationale: No accessible name: the visible label 'Member ID' is adjacent text with no for=/id= pairing, so it is recovered by the proximity pass at replay time rather than by a role+name lookup.
textbox 'Member ID' scoped to 'Member Search / Search — Primary Index'; disambiguates duplicate labels that sit in different frames or sections.
Positional last resort: match #0 of textbox 'Member ID' in document order across frames. The only strategy permitted to resolve ambiguity.
Chromium exposes this as button named 'Search', unique on screen. Portable to UI Automation and AT-SPI verbatim.
button 'Search' scoped to 'Member Search / Search — Primary Index'; disambiguates duplicate labels that sit in different frames or sections.
Positional last resort: match #0 of button 'Search' in document order across frames. The only strategy permitted to resolve ambiguity.

known_outcomes.description: The back-office session has expired and the operator must sign in again.

recovery_rules.description: A 'your session will expire soon' interstitial stands between us and the target page. Dismissing it resumes the original request with its fields intact.

dismiss_target.description: Continue button on the session interstitial

strategies.rationale: The interstitial exposes exactly one Continue control.
